output.subject: 99.2% field accuracy on invoice parsing — here's how we got it
output.pitch: Engineering teams building AP automation hit a wall with generic OCR: layout variance kills accuracy, and cloud AI needs weeks of tuning per document type. DocParse solves this with 99.2% field-level accuracy on invoices, validated on a published 5,000-document benchmark. It returns structured JSON with per-field confidence scores and human-in-the-loop fallback below your threshold. p95 latency is 1.8 seconds per page at any volume, tracked on a public metrics page. SOC 2 Type II audit is in progress. For data engineers integrating document ingestion into ERPs or three-way match systems, this means reliable throughput without custom models. {APP_URL}
